verses.text: Ayik yoxilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Joacim reyal t'a Judá, ix k'och winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' soldado, yik syak'an owal heb' t'a Jerusalén. Yuj chi' ix och hoyan heb' t'a spatik chonhab' chi'.

Ha Dios Kajalil ix ak'anoch winhaj rey Joacim chi' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' yet' juntzanhxo heb' anima aj Judá yet' jantak yamk'ab' sk'anchaj t'a stemplo Dios. Ha juntzanh yamk'ab' chi', ix yik'kot winh, ix jawi t'a Babilonia tik, ix schekan winh ak'chajoch t'a spatil sdiosal b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ak'ji t'a sdiosal winh chi'.

Ayik ix jawi heb', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Aspenaz, haton winh yajal yaj t'a heb' yilumal sdespacho winh rey chi' to sik'chajel jaywanhok heb' winh kelemtak t'a skal heb' yinhtilal heb' winh rey aj Judá chi' yet' t'a skal heb' yinhtilal heb' niwak yopisio ix ik'chajkot chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: Ha heb' winh kelemtak chi', yowalil te wach' yilji heb' winh, malaj jab'ok spaltail sniwanil heb' winh, jelan heb' winh, ay spensar heb' winh, snachajel tas yuj heb' winh, heb' winh smoj wal yak'an serwil t'a palacio. Yowalil sk'ayb'ej sti' heb' caldeo heb' winh yet' tas tz'ib'ab'il yuj heb'.

Ix yalanpax winh rey t'a winhaj Aspenaz chi' to a swael winh yet' swino winh syab'lej heb' winh kelemtak chi', sk'ayb'ajpax oxeok ab'il heb' winh. Slajwi chi', tz'och heb' winh yak' serwil winh rey chi'.

Ha t'a skal juntzanh heb' winh kelemtak ix sik'chajel yuj winhaj Aspenaz chi', hata' ayoch winhaj Daniel, winhaj Ananías, winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Azarías. Haton heb' winh tik ix kot t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Judá.

Ix k'exchaj sb'i heb' winh yuj winhaj Aspenaz chi'. Ha winhaj Daniel chi', Beltsasar ix sb'iej winh, haxo winhaj Ananías, Sadrac ix sb'iej winh, haxo pax winhaj Misael, Mesac ix sb'iej winh, haxo winhaj Azarías jun, Abed-nego ix sb'iej winh.

Ha winhaj Daniel chi', ix sna winh to manh ol swalaj juntzanh tas ay yowalil yuj sley Dios, yuj chi' ix tewi winh t'a winhaj Aspenaz chi' to max ak'ji pural winh swaan swael winh rey yet' tas syuk'ej winh.
Ix och Dios yet' winhaj Daniel chi', yuj chi' te wach' winh t'a yol sat winhaj Aspenaz chi'. Wach'chom icha chi',

palta ix yal winhaj Aspenaz chi' icha tik: --Tzin xiw t'a winh wajalil, yujto a winh ix halani tas ol he wa''a yet' tas ol eyuk'ej. Q'uinalok haxo ol yilan winh to b'aktak ex t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' winh kelemtak tik, ol am in schek miljokcham winh rey chi' eyuuj, xchi winh.
Haxo winhaj Aspenaz chi', ix yak'och jun yilumal winhaj Daniel chi' winh yet' heb' winh oxwanh kelemtak chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Daniel chi' t'a winh yilumal chi' icha tik:
--Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzonh ak' prowal t'a lajunheok k'ual. Anhej komon wael tzak' t'ayonh, mokab' ak' nok' chib'ej ko chi'a, anhej pax ha ha' tzak' kuk'ej.

Ayik stz'akwi lajunhe' k'ual chi', tzonh a lajb'an yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh kelemtak swaan swael winh rey chi'. Ichato chi' syalxo ak'an t'ayonh tas ol ko wa chi', hato syal chajtil kiljiochi, xchi winh.
Ix schaan sk'ol winh tas ix sk'an heb' winh chi'. Lajunhe' k'ual ix ak'ji prowal heb' winh.
Haxo yik ix tz'akwi lajunhe' k'ual chi', ix iljiochi to te wach' yilji heb' winh, te tek'an heb' winh t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh ix waan swael winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi', majxo ak'jilaj wael yet' wino yik winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh yuj winh yilumal heb' winh chi', haxonhej komon wael ix yak' winh t'a heb' winh.

Ha heb' winh kelemtak chi' schanhwanhil, ix ak'ji sjelanil heb' winh yuj Dios yik snachajel jantak sk'ayb'ub'al heb' aj Babilonia chi' yuj heb' winh yet' tas tz'ib'ab'il. Haxo winhaj Daniel chi', ay pax sjelanil winh snaanel tas syalelk'och juntzanh wayich yet' juntzanh tas tz'ak'ji yila'.
Haxo yik ix k'och stiempoal icha yalnakkan winh rey, ix molb'aj masanil heb' winh kelemtak ix k'ay chi' yuj winhaj Aspenaz, ix yik'anb'at heb' winh winh t'a yichanh winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi'.

Ayik ix k'och heb' winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix lolon winh yet' heb' winh, palta ha t'a skal heb' winh kelemtak chi' smasanil, malaj junok heb' winh syal slajb'an sb'a yet' heb' winh chanhwanh chi', haton winhaj Daniel, winhaj Ananías, winhaj Misael yet' winhaj Azarías. Yuj chi' ix ak'jikanoch heb' winh yak' serwil winh rey chi'.

Juntakel sk'anb'ej razón winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh yuj juntzanh jelanil yet' tastak ajaltak snachajeli, ix nachajel yuj heb' winh, lajunhel wal ek'to sjelanil spensar heb' winh chanhwanh chi' t'a yichanh masanil heb' ajchum yet' heb' naumel lolonel ay t'a yol masanil smakb'en winh.
Haxo winhaj Daniel chi' ix kannhej winh t'a yopisio chi', masanto t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ciro reyal.
